data.description: Authorities have reported a major outbreak in a city with over 1,500 confirmed cases of a new virus strain. The city has been placed under lockdown, with strict measures being implemented to contain the spread of the virus. Health officials are urging residents to follow hygiene protocols and stay indoors to prevent further transmission. Emergency response teams are being mobilized to provide support and medical assistance to those affected by the outbreak. The government is working closely with healthcare organizations to ensure adequate resources are allocated to handle the situation effectively. The situation is being closely monitored and updates will be provided as new information becomes available.

data.title: Minnesota leads regulation fight over prediction markets, banning Kalshi and Polymarket first. Federal lawsuit could determine regulatory authority.
data.description: The first state to enact legislation prohibiting Kalshi and Polymarket has sparked legal conflict, as a federal agency has filed a lawsuit that could establish regulatory authority over these platforms. This decision sets a critical precedent regarding oversight of prediction markets, marking a significant development in the enforcement landscape.

data.title: Cursor MCP Server Now Powered by ZoomInfo as the GTM Context Layer
data.description: VANCOUVER, Wash.--ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) recently revealed that its MCP Server is now accessible on the Cursor Marketplace. This development offers developers and revenue teams a seamless method to incorporate ZoomInfo's confirmed GTM data into Cursor's AI coding agent. Users of SpaceXAI can easily add the integration from the Cursor Marketplace with just one command. Subsequently, Cursor agent interactions can utilize ZoomInfo's verified GTM data as a primary data source, enhancing functionality and efficiency.
